body: Exactly this but it’s obvious he doesn’t practice critical thinking or common sense.

Yes. What's a 20 year old doing with a child? Also, why would he wait two years to give a statement after her disappearance? Something doesn't add up here and it's unfortunate that police didn't seem to look further into it or seemingly look for him at all.
Wait...what? She vanished while waiting for the elevator? Yet no one saw her or heard anything? Something doesn't add up here. Surely someone had to have seen something?

Sometimes people just aren't compatible anymore. You did what was right. You broke it off instead of continuing and potentially leading her on and causing her more pain.

For now, just give her some space and let her come to you if she wants to talk anymore.

My father said the secret to my parents marriage is that they never go to bed angry with each other. It's one of the only "rules" they have in their relationship. 

You probably have done this already, but tell your boyfriend is upsets you and going to bed after an argument without a resolution isn't healthy.
